status_definitions.implemented-offline: Main implementation exists with offline verification; not a claim of complete online acceptance.
status_definitions.partial: Some implementation exists; full roadmap acceptance remains open.
status_definitions.external-contract-needed: External API contract or environment evidence is required before integration can be enabled.

modules.name: 编号选择与切换
modules.limitations: Numbered choices are config/version-bound; existing tasks stay pinned. Offline providers identify matches exact saved names, model/remote IDs, platforms and families with canonical-ID priority, preserving disabled/archived ambiguity. It does not parse arbitrary natural language, decrypt credentials, certify readiness or assign existing tasks. Codex extracts terms and passes unredacted canonical IDs through normal selection/request preflight. Arbitrary aliases and all creation entry points still need further audit. Task filters expose parameter/count matches, exclusions and unknown contracts without replacing stable numbered selection.
modules.online_acceptance: Not claimed by source implementation; consult binding receipts and the dated acceptance report.

modules.name: Windows 管理器
entry_points: 项目与任务 · 渲染当前时间线
项目与任务 · 导出交付清单
modules.limitations: Native catalog, authoring and local render/delivery forms share core services. The explicit task panel adds token-bound route/budget previews, numbered once/project choices, generation/recovery/retry and existing reconciliation/settlement receipt import. Portable EXE verified locally; clean-machine, human visual review, temporal-slice form and broader task controls remain pending. Widget-owned variables remove Tcl traces on UI teardown; catalog/media workers carry service data only and detach callbacks on closure. CPython interpreter lifetime is guarded across later worker GC; this does not establish human or clean-machine acceptance. Close/reload checks preserve unapplied config, price, credential, authoring, local-import and policy drafts on cancellation; local transactions block user closure while remote task panels remain detachable. Invalid JSON now opens an offline repair editor with byte-bound preview/apply, exact original backups, protected known identities and read-only newer formats. Unparseable originals cannot prove all historical identities. Windows pending configuration and upstream/model/price/media-settings forms have DPAPI checkpoints every 1.5 seconds and explicit same-version, stopped-owner recovery against unchanged configuration. Credential input and project/task/selection forms are excluded; no plaintext fallback or automatic configuration save. Broader draft recovery remains open. Task-oriented catalog filters share scalar/count validators, explain exclusions and unknown contracts, and change the view only; they do not establish credentials, complete references or request readiness. Catalog changes have a native cached/live viewer with configuration/source checks before unsaved draft import.
modules.online_acceptance: No generation or provider connection is performed by filtering/comparison. Current live bindings and reference failures remain recorded independently; UI readiness does not certify model quality.

modules.online_acceptance: 2026-11-12: Seedance2.5-V text-only 5-second test and 30-second comedy downloaded and decoded. 2026-11-13: one separate v2 mixed-reference probe accepted then failed generically; no completed reference output or quality acceptance. Actual billing remains unknown.

Model reference semantics remain unverified; test links revoked. Earlier localhost fixture recovery remains separately evidenced.

modules.name: 脱敏诊断预览与导出
modules.limitations: Allowlisted saved-config, contract, cache and per-operation evidence summaries. Default aliases omit identities; optional model IDs and API host require local preview. No external credential lookup, network or creates. Inline values already saved in JSON are used only for label redaction and omitted. Source and current summaries must match before atomic no-replace export on a local filesystem with hardlink support. Reports do not establish complete request readiness, provider availability, price payment or content quality. Raw logs, task/media URLs and project-wide diagnosis are outside this report.

modules.name: 配置草稿加密暂存与异常退出恢复
modules.limitations: Windows DPAPI only; 1.5-second UI-loop checkpoints of pending configuration and upstream/model/price/media-settings forms. Explicit recovery requires a proven stopped original process, same manager version and unchanged saved configuration. Invalid raw form text is retained for editing; recovered data still requires normal apply/save. Unsubmitted credential input, project/task/selection/repair forms, cross-version migration and power-loss durability are excluded. No generation, network or credential-store writes.
modules.online_acceptance: Local feature; stopped-process recovery requires actual process-termination acceptance in the dated release record.

modules.name: 本机上游配置 Web（候选）
modules.limitations: Local Vue/FastAPI upstream configuration only; URL/Key encrypted save, immutable previews, conflict/replay protection, backups and byte-preserving repair, exact catalog drafts, explicit XingAPI V text recipe, independent defaults, structured common/typed image-video-audio limits, combinations, conditional duration, quote/budget/tier editing plus JSON, offline fit/compare, per-operation evidence and anonymous diagnostics. No generation/project/media-job API. Known recipe covers exact seedance2.5-V text-to-video on the explicit XingAPI address; additional exact model/operation contracts remain pending; hard budgets support additive per-request/per-second only and other units remain display quotes. Seven-day source/form-bound recovery covers upstream metadata, model forms, defaults and controlled backup IDs, tested across eight real forced server exits and actual isolated Chrome termination with lost sessionStorage identifiers. Explicit config-scoped metadata discovery supports recovery and version-checked disposal of expired/unsupported/corrupt drafts. Exact byte-version checks protect save/claim/discard across shared-cookie tabs and real competing processes; conflicts retain input and permit an explicit fork. Advisory draft cleanup cannot reverse successful configuration save. Keys, raw configuration, arbitrary paths and invalid/unknown advanced JSON fields are excluded. Inputs not yet acknowledged by debounce/network/disk may be lost on forced exit. Optional price removal restores unknown rather than zero. Tk idle-theme teardown warning is fixed with an unsilenced regression and full core run. Candidate remains unreleased dev44; installed dev43 and live 8765 are retained. Real Chrome 100/125/150/175/200 percent zoom, five pages, keyboard/focus, long labels and hit-tested dialog actions are verified; high-zoom action clipping is fixed by scrolling only the form body. Damaged-config startup loads local backup metadata before repair-draft recovery. Duplicate labels/exact remote case, concurrent filtered menus, independent media/project choices and ambiguous legacy platform aliases are tested after Web changes. Human screen-reader/clean-machine acceptance and live media-service switch are not claimed. Budget calculations and explanations share one function, distinguishing missing/unverified/future/expired/currency/time/tier-context/no-match/overlap reasons and displaying additive rates after minimum/ceiling seconds; nonfinite estimates stay unknown. Image comparisons omit video duration. Scenario/selection/config changes invalidate prior results and delayed responses. Actual local history audit resolves 130 v3 snapshots unchanged after synthetic Web edits; 170 old records retain preexisting platform-alias ambiguity and are not claimed recovered. Records include saved revisions. No real credential decryption or provider request in history audit. Full regression additionally exposed a Windows cooldown reader blocking atomic replacement; reader and writer now share the same lock, with deterministic held-handle regression. Minimal Web venv lacks Pillow; core regression preflights the established complete runtime. Image per_image budgets count explicitly transmitted requested outputs, add per-request fees and replace parent rates on tier selection; omitted n stays unknown. Image rates cannot mix video/duration semantics. Old dev43 rejects the new field; actual payment remains unknown.
modules.online_acceptance: Synthetic configuration and local fake servers only; zero paid probes. This module does not certify provider availability, billing or media quality.

work_packages.requirement: 建立机器可读模块目录和统一状态口径；每模块有真实入口、限制、实测范围、测试/文档证据和对应待办，旧清单逐项映射而不重复计数。
设计配置 Schema v4、草稿/启用语义及扩展策略；模型、上游、binding、route 继续分层；不完整草稿可保存但不可执行。
model/upstream/binding 增加中文展示名、notes、tags、文档链接、收藏/排序和来源时间；备注不改变任务输入哈希，不升级能力。
以操作为单位定义提示词计数、时长、分辨率、画幅、多媒体数量/大小/时长与组合限制；未知不是无限，空枚举不是“全支持”。
分离供应商声明、执行合同、用户覆写、逐能力证据；拆分协议/能力、价格、展示与请求指纹，修改标价不误使内容审核过期。
版本化计价：按次/秒/张、条件档位、组别、币种、取整/最低计费和有效期；估算与实付分开，未知报价不可满足硬金额上限。
增加非秘密账户身份、凭据版本与凭据录入服务；同账户轮换、切账户、改 URL 区分处理；活动任务可找到原账户和允许使用凭据的地址。
配置读改写事务、修订号、并发冲突、备份恢复、引用检查、归档；不允许删除仍被未完成任务引用的上游或破坏其凭据恢复。
v3→v4 dry-run、变更差异、应用及回滚；旧默认/自定义字段按明确策略保留，未知新版只读而不覆盖；回滚不丢新任务快照。
导入 /models、手工录入与来源备注；目录新增/移除仅提示差异，不自动启用、删本地备注或认定能力；同名远端别名不自动合并。
双向目录：上游→型号、家族→型号→上游；可按任务、操作、时长、画幅、参考数量筛选，输出人读表格及机器结果。
解析明确组合、只给上游、只给型号、均未给四类输入；唯一路线直接使用，歧义时只询问缺失选择；保留本会话已有选择。
菜单序号绑定 selection_id、配置修订、候选稳定 ID 和任务参数；处理过期、重排、非法序号、跨项目回复与并发菜单。
本次/项目/全局选择范围和来源；恢复旧任务优先原快照；仅用户明确要求才把一次选择保存为以后默认。
统一 route explain 与费用预演：列最终选择、参数消费、排除理由、来源、报价状态；选定路线就绪检查不被无关坏上游阻断。
切换前显示已提交、未知、已完成、未提交镜头；只调整指定的新任务；默认固定，备用需明确策略且只在确认未受理时执行。
在图片/视频所有创建入口统一检查选择；非交互缺项返回 selection_required 且零创建，离线策划不被该选择挡住。
将配置/选型服务与 CLI 展示分离，供界面直接调用；确定轻量桌面技术方案，不从界面拼接任意 shell 命令或复制执行逻辑。
上游增改/复制/归档、凭据遮蔽录入、型号增改与启用；3 个不同上游、多个家族可以纯表单配置。
能力与备注表单、价格页、状态徽标；展示“声明支持但 adapter 未实现”，动态约束与核心校验一致。
搜索、收藏、排序、并排比较和适用场景；单独设置图片/视频默认，显示费用单位与是否已确认。
保存前校验、差异预览、未保存提醒、冲突处理、修复无效 JSON 和恢复备份；显示实际读取路径与配置版本。
只读连接/目录检查、证据详情、脱敏诊断导出；检查按钮不会生成媒体；生成试测有独立入口与范围。
Windows 分发、干净机器启动、离线配置、升级与卸载；保留用户数据；明确依赖、签名/校验和及真实包体，不承诺未经测量的“小体积”。
取得星光实际 API 文档/脱敏合同样例，核对 create/query/download/upload、ID、错误语义和账户报价；页面 OPENAI 标签不作为协议证据。
将 Seedance2.5-V 做成独立 binding；协议一致则复用 adapter，不一致则新增版本；5–30 秒、实际 ID、720P、音频与按次报价各自验收。
分别登记并验证 Seedance2.5-S 与 933/C/Q；不继承 V 的计价或参数；仅开放已核对的操作组合。
Wan 独立家族/型号/绑定，核验 Wan3.0-Prime-720P 合同；同协议复用，新协议单独 adapter；与其他上游 Wan 的等价性另记。
参考输入统一类型、角色和时间区间；扩展项目校验、编译、快照与审核；旧 opening-frame 图片行为保持兼容。
按实需实现文件/URL/asset_id 上传、失效重传、来源哈希、过期和恢复；禁止静默丢视频/音频或把参考视频降为首帧。
适配字符/字节计数、混合参考和条件参数，实际 payload 字段有消费报告；整批错误在任何创建/预算预留之前发现。
按合同补查询、下载、异步/SSE 及可选 cancel/idempotency；幂等和取消必须由真实服务支持，不能本地假实现；型号硬编码迁入版本化限制。
保留现有 unknown 保护并统一失败分类；超时/5xx/仅 trace ID 不自动重发；内容失败不得触发无痕换站。
区分共享账户/容量组的提交并发、远端在途、RPM、轮询与下载配额；进程重启和多个 binding 不能绕过限制。
按故障范围的冷却、Retry-After、退避/抖动和进度；不把一个型号失败等同全站失败，不通过付费探针自动恢复健康。
验证改默认、改显示名、凭据同账户轮换、旧上游归档后仍恢复原任务；切账户/改域名需要保留原实例，不能误用新凭据。
新价格结构接入原预留/结算账本；失败收费、退款、未知、跨币种分别显示；生成秒数、保留秒数、已审核可用秒数分开。
可重建的项目/任务索引与只读任务面板；显示队列、未知提交、候选、审核和费用；不复制一份会与 state.json 漂移的运行状态。
统一阶段索引、状态、输入输出版本、阻塞原因和下一步；阶段文件引用现有 job/review，不平行维护任务真相。
主题/受众/目标/规格的引导采集与大纲阅读稿；足够信息可继续，缺失偏好只询问影响创作的部分。
定义通用剧本创作/投射层：场景、动作、台词、情绪与 beat/shot 映射；阅读稿与结构化源有明确单向导出或版本化导入。
流程分支覆盖单镜、图生视频、原创/改编动画、科普、连载、独立系列、仅剪辑、纯图/GIF；无关阶段可跳过并记录原因。
逐步审阅/按授权自动推进策略；不每镜重新选上游，不每阶段机械求确认；付费前仍校验既有授权范围和预算。
主题、剧本、分镜、参考、声音与模型参数的逐层映射；早期能力预演、最终请求预检；可解释一个镜头为何如此生成。

项目 status/next 的统一查询入口与步骤面板；“继续制作”能定位当前阶段和可复用产物，而不是从头开始。
标准交付清单：成片/小样、字幕、分镜阅读稿、来源和素材映射、路线与成本、未核实项；草稿与正式验收明确区分。
建立跨项目角色/场景/道具/声音索引及素材浏览；引用时复制或快照哈希，来源修改不悄悄改变已建立项目。
身份、服装、表情、美术与镜头构图分开；提供原图/首帧/视频对照板和角色版本更新影响清单。
